comment: Single source of truth for files the autonomous agent may NEVER modify, rename, or delete. Consumed by: (1) the CI guardrail job (.github/scripts/guardrail.mjs), (2) the Railway worker's pre-push diff check, (3) the agent's tool-permission deny rules, and (4) the GitHub push ruleset (kept in sync by hand). Patterns ending in /** protect an entire directory; all other entries are exact file paths.
